children: Lesaka Technologies Inc reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $721.6M, up from $659.7M a year earlier, and net income attributable to Lesaka of $2.8M versus a net loss of $91M in FY 2025.
Revenue was $721.6M for FY 2026, compared with $659.7M in FY 2025; YoY change 9.4%.
Net income attributable to Lesaka was $2.8M for FY 2026, compared with a net loss of $91.0M in FY 2025 (swing to profit).
Diluted earnings per share: metric omitted from Part II Item 7 / Item 8 disclosures.
Consolidated revenue growth of about 9% was driven by consumer lending, insurance, and the inclusion of Utilities and MobileMart businesses.
Merchant reporting shifted to focus on active merchants and ARPU (90‑day activity) rather than device proof-of-performance metrics.
Launched a unified "One Lesaka" master brand in November 2025 to consolidate merchant-facing brands and reduce duplication.
Operational moves included exiting the ATM business, winding down non-core assets, completing major integrations (Adumo, Utilities) and closing Atom/MobileMart.
Key operating metrics: consumer active base increased ~11% and consumer ARPU rose ~15%; merchant ARPU declined modestly while ADP and supplier-enabled payments TPV showed strong growth.
